reviews.title: Lose All Your Photos
reviews.text: Terrible. I took some photos in San Francisco because I liked the quality the app gave off. I stupidly didn’t take any with my regular camera. This was at the beginning of February. Suddenly the photos wouldn’t sync, I couldn’t see them or download them. I read about other having the same issue and they warned if you deleted and redownloaded the app, the pictures would disappear and the team unable to recover them. So I kept the app. I contacted customer service. I didn’t hear back. Over 6 months ago. They released an update that should’ve fixed the problem, but instead the snaps were still not syncing, and when I tried the option to download all old snaps as a zip file so I could recover them, it turns out that option was not really available. There was a tiny window in which to recover the zip file. So now it’s too late, I saw the snaps, could only retrieve them in a zip file, which was no longer available to download, followed by an announcement that they’ve dissolved their customer service team and won’t help anyone with requests from prior to May 2026. Too bad, out of luck! What they don’t tell you is even if you sent a help request in FEBRUARY they still won’t help, they’ll just wait until after the arbitrary deadline and then you’re out of luck and they will just close off their inbox to everyone. Absurd.

reviews.title: It’s not the same, just a waste of storage space
reviews.text: I got the app originally in 2023 and it was by far my favorite social media app. You used to be able to assign a song for each month and to your profile but eventually that aspect was lost. I loved being able to follow my friends and see only the photos my friends shared. That it was truly set it apart for me. In a world full of social media apps that constantly shove content at you showing anything but the actual social life of your friends, Lapse stood out. That social aspect was also eventually lost because they changed to social page into a page where you would only see the posts of random people and your friends post were tucked away into a story format. That basically ruined the app completely for me, but still having the ability to see my friends’ photos and share my own kept me on it. Now there is no music and no social aspect. It’s basically an app that puts a filter in your photos at this point. It’s a waste of my storage space now. I’m really upset to have to delete it after how amazing and different it was at the very beginning. I really hope they bring the old Lapse back.

reviews.title: The new update
reviews.text:
I really don’t like the recent changes to Lapse. The app used to feel meaningful and enjoyable, but the new version has taken away some of the best features.
Being able to make friends and use the journaling feature was what made Lapse different and special. It felt personal, social, and reflective. Now that those features are gone, the app feels more empty and less engaging, and I don’t really see the point of using it in the same way.
It feels like the app has moved away from what users actually enjoyed. The changes honestly feel like a downgrade rather than an improvement. I really hope you reconsider these updates or bring back features that allow connection and journaling, because that’s what made Lapse worth using.

reviews.title: Disappointment with the new update
reviews.text: I’m really disappointed with the new Lapse update. Removing the chat function and taking away the ability to see other people’s pictures and journals completely ruins what made the app feel social and meaningful. It used to be a fun, intimate way to connect with friends, but now it feels empty and disconnected. Instead of improving the experience, the update stripped away the features that kept me coming back. I honestly don’t see the point of using the app anymore unless they bring those core features back.
